text:
A current-carrying conductor placed in a magnetic field experiences a force.
Which changes result in reversing the direction of the force?
A
Decrease the current, keeping the field direction constant.
B
Increase the current and reverse the field direction.
C
Increase the current, keeping the field direction constant.
D
Reverse the current and reverse the field direction.

options.label: A
options.text: Decrease the current, keeping the field direction constant.

options.label: B
options.text: Increase the current and reverse the field direction.

options.label: C
options.text: Increase the current, keeping the field direction constant.

options.label: D
options.text: Reverse the current and reverse the field direction.
